cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a street food stall at night under a tarp — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — dries her hair with a towel; a rocky coast path with tide pools — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a medieval tavern — holds her keepsake at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — sitting on the ground; a sheltered coastal ferry waiting area with coloured glass wind screens — she holds a paper pinwheel against the breeze to pass the wait; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — holds her keepsake at chest height; terraced tea fields on a misty Sichuan hillside — kneeling on the ground; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — rests a red oil-paper umbrella open on her shoulder; a grand museum hall with marble statues at night — holds a freshly printed instant photo up to the light
